name: h2_greedy_plus_3_teacher_validation

cache_key.note: The cache keeps the first 100 seeds at or after val_seed_start whose teacher route is feasible. It is not the raw seed block 11200000-11200099.

temperature_scope: sampled route and customer logits after the feasibility mask; greedy argmax is not scaled
returned_route: shortest feasible among 1 greedy and 3 samples; ties keep the earlier candidate, greedy first
cost: sum of the four decode runtimes and frvcpy executions
infeasible_return: if no candidate is feasible, the penalized duration is 100 h, which is n times T_max
decision_rule: A temperature is promising if at least 4 of 5 seeds have a negative RL-minus-BC penalized anchored duration and the paired Student-t 95% interval lies entirely below zero. Both temperatures are reported. This validation split was already used for checkpoint selection.
